description: GAMMA_COLLAPSE_ALGORITHM spike (GAMMA_COLLAPSE_ALGORITHM_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md). Rung 4 (mint-on-recurrence) of the SAME collapse-mint algorithm the sd loop (shape_decode.rs) and MetaShapeMint already realise, applied to Type-1 Gamma rejections instead of shape-decode residuals. Rung 1 (recognize) is `check_edge` itself, UNCHANGED -- an admitted edge never reaches this seed at all. When Rust's `Substrate::add_edge` hits `CheckOutcome::Type1NoProduction` with `gamma_residual_capture` on (default OFF, see substrate.rs field doc), it mints ONE `GammaResidual{src_type,edge_type,tgt_type,hit_count,proposed}` node per rejection -- mechanical event logging, no Rust-side dedup or counting decision, anchored under a lazily-created `GammaResidualRoot` via an UNCHECKED `gamma_residual` edge (engine-internal bookkeeping, the same category as `add_production`'s own GammaProduction mirror). Every decision from there is this ONE rule, using ONLY existing Count/Filter/Argmin/StringConcat Terms: `note_gamma_production_gap` groups GammaResidual nodes by their exact (src_type,edge_type,tgt_type) attrs (already canonical -- a fixed 3-tuple, neither order-dependent nor truncated, unlike the CapabilityAxis bug SHAPE_AUDIT.md Section 3.1 documents), applies shape_decode.rs's OWN support discipline verbatim (support >= 2 mints, support 1 does not -- TWO is not a swept knob, it is the smallest cardinality at which 'recurs' is defined, shape_decode.rs:8795-8797), picks ONE canonical leader per group via the retire_duplicate_gap Argmin-over-node-identity idiom (gap_awareness.json, so a group of N residuals mints ONCE per run_rules fixpoint rather than N times), and mints a `SelfConcern{status:'noted', source:'implicit', kind:'gamma_production', content:<the triple, human-readable>}` -- the EXACT SAME node shape gap_awareness.json's two mint rules already produce, so the existing human-gated `promote_self_concern` (scripts/jabberwock_daemon.py) and the existing surfacing reader (`domains.reflective_faculty._run_self_gaps`, which unions a full SelfConcern scan as a fallback so no `has_self_concern` edge is required for discovery -- deliberately omitted here, since there is no reliable single-Agent anchor at this grain and forcing one would repeat the ['agent','is_a','Agent'] over-firing anti-pattern CLAUDE.md's gap_awareness section explicitly rejects) both discover and can promote it with ZERO code changes. Content-deduped (Not Exists a SelfConcern with the same content, the gap_awareness.json idiom verbatim) and mint-once via a `proposed` guard on the leader residual, exactly like `gap_noted`/`comprehended` elsewhere. WHAT THIS SEED DOES NOT DO, STATED HONESTLY: it never calls `add_production` and never makes a rejected triple admissible -- Theorem XII (reference-monitor containment) is untouched by this seed; making a proposal live is an explicit, out-of-band, human/experiment-equivalent action outside any rule, demonstrated manually in GAMMA_COLLAPSE_ALGORITHM_RESULTS.md. It also does not add a `gamma_production`-specific StandingConcern pipeline handler (the code_write/prog_read precedent in `_promote_relations_for_concern`) -- a promoted concern of this kind falls through to the generic comprehend_first default, which is a named, honest, out-of-scope residual, not a silent gap.
